book.name: Jone
book.title: WAI PII EPE JONEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Taono Kena Dokonya Mirakolo Piamo Doko
Pilipapa Natanielepa wii lao nyia dokonya pituu yuu gii lapo pateamopa tepo dokonya, yuu Galali taono Kena dokonya enda watapae piami mendenya Jisasa endangi doko petea.
Jisasapi, baanya disaipolopi, dupa apata enda watapae piami dokonya epena leaminopa pupala kateamiaka.
Dokopa waene sia dupa nao etapeaminopa, Jisasanya endangi dokome Jisasa lamaiyoo, “Waene etalame-lamona” lea.
Dopa leamopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Enda, nambanya gii doko ene epelyamona, doko nalimbanya kalai mendepe?”

content: lea.
Dokopa baanya endangi dokome kalai akali dupa lamaiyoo, “Nyakamame mende pyepa laapomona, baame latali pyepape” lea.

Endaki penge kaname wasepae tokange dosa sia. Penge dutupanya mendai-mendai lao endaki 100 litapi mende petenge. Penge dopale dupanya Juu dupame endaki kamuu pisetala, nyakamanya mana singili pyoo kaimala pyoo wasoo nepengema.
Jisasame kalai akali dokaita lamaiyoo,
lea. Dokopa dokaitame endaki kamuu tumbasiami.
Dopa peteaminopa baame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Indupa dokonya mendatupa kamuu nyepala nee isilyamo akali doko maiya pupa”

content: lea. Dopa leamopa dokaitame maiya peami.

Maitiaminopa, nee isia akali dokome endaki doko nao siamopa waene jiamosa, baame anja-tae nyalamipi lao masala naeya. Dopaka doko, kalai akali endaki kamuu nyiami dupame masiami. Nee isia akali dokome enda watapae pia akali doko epena latala

lamaiyoo, “Endakali pitakame waene epe dupa wambao mokosoo maingima. Waene epe dupa longo lao napelyaminopa, maitakao koo dupa mokosoo maingima. Dopa pingimana, embame waene epe dake sina kaeyapala, epapu nyoo epelyenona” lea.
Yuu Galali taono Kena dokonya, Jisasame mirakolo pia dupa pitakanya mirakolo dake wambao pia. Dopa pia dokome, baanya tii pipae doko paneamosa, baanya disaipolo dupame baa tungi piami.
Dokopa Jisasa baanya endangipi, kaiminingipi, disaipolopi, dupa-pipa lanao Kapename pupala, yuu gii kuki mendatupa dokonya kateami.
Lotuu Anda Nee Nyetae Kamapu Dokonya Maketa Daa Leamo Doko
Juumanya Pasopa nee nenge gii doko ipanya piamopa, Jisasa lalyoo Jerusalema pea.
Pupala kandeamopa, lotuu anda nee nyetae kamapu dokonya kaowapi, sipisipipi, yaka maiyoleepi dupa maketa setao kateaminopa, muni aloo pingima dupame muni aloo pyoo nyakamanya toko dupanya peteami.

Dopa piaminosa, Jisasame kende mendapu nyoo kambu pyatala, kende konja mende wasia. Wasepala kende konja dokome sipisipipi, kaowapi dupa pitaka konja palyoo nepatala, lotuu anda nee nyetae dokonya kamaka pena lao watao pia. Dopa petala, muni aloo pingima dupanya muni konde dupa kai lao nepatala, toko dupa nyoo kapilyia.
Dopa petala yaka maiyolee salimi leami dupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakamame nambanya Takangenya anda dake maketa anda jala naenya, dokaita nyoo pupa”

content: lea.
Dokopa, pii pepa pyapae singi dokonya, “Gote, embanya anda doko nee kaenge dokome namba lyaa minatana” lapae singina lao baanya disaipolo dupame masiami.
Jisasame dopa pia dokonya Juu dupame baa lamaiyoo, “Embame pilyino datupa pipenge kyeto doko emba-kisa silyamona lao panasoo, mirakolo aipale mende naimame kanjepale lao pitipi?” leami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasame dokaitanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo,

content.text: “Anda nee nyetae dake nyakamame kalunya nepataminopa, yuu gii tepomanya nambame dee katasotona”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa Juu dupame lao pituu, “Anda nee nyetae dake pyoaka kateaminopa ee kana 46 peana, embame yuu gii tepo dutupanya iki katasetepe?” leami.
Jisasame anda nee nyetae lea doko, baanya yonge doko lao lea.
Jisasa malunya sakatateamopa, baame pii lea dutupa baanya disaipolo dupame masiami. Gotenya pii pepa pyapae singipi, Jisasanya pii lea dutupapi, dupa kiningi-lamo lao masiamiaka.
Jisasame Endakali Pitaka Kandao Tii Tenge
Pasopa nee nenge gii dokonya Jerusalema katao Jisasame mirakolo pia dupa endakali longome kandatala baanya kenge dokonya tungi piami.
Dopaka doko, Jisasame endakali dupa pitakanya masiami dupa kandatala, baame dupa tungi pyala naeya.
Jisasame endakali pitaka kandao tii tenge dokonyana, endakali dupa dopalena lao endakali mendeme Jisasa lamaiya naeyapenge.
